# DegradedSwitch

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `DegradedSwitchInspection`

A `switch` with only a `default` branch, or with a single `case` (optionally
plus `default`), is just an `if` / `if-else` (or plain code) in disguise and
reads better rewritten that way.

## Example

```php{3,7,15}
<?php
function route($verb) {
    switch ($verb) {
        case 'GET':
            serve();
    }
    switch (strtoupper($verb)) {
        default:
            reject();
            break;
        case 'POST':
            store();
            break;
    }
    switch ($verb):
        default:
            fallback();
    endswitch;

    switch ($verb) {}
    switch ($verb) {
        case 'PUT':
        case 'PATCH':
            update();
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: This switch has a single case; an &#39;if&#39; is clearer.</li>
<li>line 7: This switch has a single case and a default; an &#39;if&#39;/&#39;else&#39; is clearer.</li>
<li>line 15: This switch only has a default branch; keep just its body.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DegradedSwitch": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DegradedSwitch

/**
 * @noinspection DegradedSwitchInspection
 */
```
